title: スプリンターズSの後に・証明？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O and Nishino Flower have been neck-and-neck whenever they compete, but Bakushin O manages to win by a hair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, after I encourage her to defeat Nishino Flower by a staggering margin, Sakura Bakushin O's passion heats up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deeply touched by my words, she aims for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, looking to face Nishino Flower once more.
